title: rosa canina var. tomentella
intro: Rosa canina var. tomentella, commonly known as the hairy-leafed dog rose, is a variety of the dog rose plant (Rosa canina) characterized by its hairy leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. tomentella include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
